title: Fragile
text: Fragile. Edge damaged and shedding immediately. Perhaps this is just too fragile. I tested it to see if it was worth replacing with an undamaged one. It's not. If you're just going to  step on this and then off out of the shower, absorbency is going to satisfy. If there's going to be more water than that, expect the water to seep through and appear on the underside. A diatomite bathroom mat is a good idea in theory, but it really needs to be less fragile, and more absorbent to justify having to regularly sand it down when the pores get clogged.

product_metadata.title: Momo Lifestyle Stone Bath Mat Drytomita Technology Diatomaceous Earth Bath Mat, Non-Slip Super Absorbent Quick Drying Shower Mat Bathroom Accessory for Home Spa (23.6 X 15.4 Inches) Linen Grey
features: Momo Lifestyle's fast drying stone bath mat gives you the opportunity to upgrade your bathroom into a spa with minimal effort! Experience the unique feel of absorption under your feet thanks to our material's porous and smooth design free of excessive engraving that often becomes difficult to clean and reduces absorbtion over time.

Made from 100% naturally occuring materials, you may bathe and shower in comfort knowing your product is waiting for you to absorb water from the moment you step out onto it. Available in two modern gray shades to compliment any bathroom interior, and two sizes to cater to your space, our grande size mat has already been featured on The Spruce as their favorite large bath mat.

Designed to absorb more than 1.5 times it's weight in water thanks to its naturally absorbent mineral composition, the Drytomita dries much faster than traditional fabric mats. Users may also find multiple uses for the product around their home as a result, such as for pet bowls, or even around exterioir swimming pools or hot tubs for a quick drying effect.

The naturally porous characteristics of the diatomaceous stone used by Momo make it naturally non slip, providing natural grip whilst also being softer than bathroom flooring to ensure our mat won't ever scratch or damage your elegant bathroom floor!

You'll spend less and save on your water bill by no longer having to frequently wash your fabric bath mats, not to mention having to dry and tidy your bathroom from accumulated moisture and dirt. Cleaning your Drytomita also couldn't be easier, simply sand the product with the sandpaper sheet provided every once in a while to preserve your mat's luxurious look!
Simple innovation for you, that's our motto at Momo! We stick by our products, which is why they all come with 1 year of Momo Care for your peace of mind!
